item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 4 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 4 #NCR_PRSD
Issued at: 5:04 AM, 12 September 2026(Saturday)

Moderate to heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over Bulacan (Obando, Meycauayan, Bocaue, Marilao, Balagtas, Guiguinto, Calumpit, Plaridel, San Jose del Monte, and Santa Maria), Laguna (Famy, Siniloan, Mabitac, Pangil, and Pakil), Metro Manila (Navotas, Valenzuela, Malabon, Caloocan, Quezon City, and Manila), Quezon (General Nakar, Infanta, Atimonan, Agdangan, Unisan, Catanauan, General Luna, and Buenavista), and Rizal (Rodriguez and Tanay) within the next 2 hours.

The above condition is affecting Bulacan (Paombong, Malolos, Bulakan, Hagonoy, Norzagaray, and Dona Remedios Trinidad), Laguna (Santa Maria), and Quezon (San Francisco, San Andres, San Narciso, and Mulanay) which may persist within 2 hours.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.

item.title: Rainfall Advisory No. 23 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Rainfall Advisory No. 23 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Southwest Monsoon (Habagat)
Issued at: 2:00 PM, 11 September 2026(Friday)

Light to moderate with occasional heavy rains are expected over Laguna, Pampanga, Tarlac, Zambales(Olongapo, Subic, Botolan, San Marcelino, Cabangan, Iba, Palauig, Castillejos, San Antonio, San Felipe, San Narciso) and Nueva Ecija(Cabiao, Gapan, San Antonio, San Isidro, Aliaga, Cabanatuan, Jaen, Licab, Penaranda, Quezon, San Leonardo, Santa Rosa, Santo Domingo, Zaragoza, Guimba, Nampicuan).

Light to moderate rains affecting Bataan(Abucay, Dinalupihan, Hermosa, Orani, Samal, Balanga, Pilar, Orion), Metro Manila(Quezon City, Caloocan, Valenzuela, Malabon, Manila, San Juan, Mandaluyong, Marikina, Pasig, Navotas), Quezon(Buenavista, Catanauan, Mulanay, San Andres, San Francisco, San Narciso), Bulacan(San Jose del Monte, Bocaue, Bulakan, Meycauayan, Marilao, Obando, Santa Maria), Rizal(Cainta, Rodriguez, San Mateo, Antipolo), Batangas(Tuy, Balayan, Calatagan, Lian, Nasugbu, Calaca, Lemery) and Cavite(General Emilio Aguinaldo, Magallanes, Maragondon, Ternate, Naic, Tanza, Trece Martires, Alfonso, Indang, Mendez) and may affect nearby areas.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 5:00 PM today.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to www.pagasa.dost.gov.ph.

item.title: Rainfall Advisory No. 34 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 34-Final #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Southwest Monsoon (Habagat)
Issued at: 11:00 AM, 11 September 2026(Friday)

Light to moderate rains was observed over Bataan, Zambales, Pampanga and Bulacan for the past 3 hours. With this development all RAINFALL WARNING in these areas are now terminated.Meanwhile, expect light to moderate with occasional heavy rains over Zambales, Bulacan, Rizal, Tarlac(San Jose, Capas, Mayantoc, Bamban, Camiling, San Clemente, Santa Ignacia, Concepcion), Metro Manila(Quezon City, Valenzuela, Caloocan, Malabon, Manila, Navotas, Marikina), Laguna(Santa Maria, Siniloan, Famy, Mabitac, Pakil, Pangil, Paete), Cavite(Cavite City, Kawit, Noveleta, Rosario, Tanza, Naic, Maragondon, Ternate, Magallanes) and Batangas(Nasugbu, Lian, Calatagan, Balayan, Tuy) within the next 3 hours.
Light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Pampanga(Angeles, San Fernando, Bacolor), Bataan(Limay, Orion, Pilar, Balanga, Abucay, Samal), Nueva Ecija(Pantabangan, Bongabon, San Jose) and Quezon(San Andres, San Francisco, Tagkawayan) which may persist within 3 hours.
The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are still advised to MONITOR the weather condition.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to www.pagasa.dost.gov.ph.

item.title: Rainfall Advisory No. 33 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 33 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Southwest Monsoon (Habagat)
Issued at: 8:00 AM, 11 September 2026(Friday)

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Bataan, Zambales(Subic, Olongapo, Castillejos, San Marcelino, San Antonio, San Narciso, San Felipe), Pampanga(Sasmuan, Lubao, Macabebe, Masantol, Floridablanca) and Bulacan(Hagonoy, Paombong, Calumpit).
